spec.description: The original search specification used to generate this result.

similaritySearchResult.description: The similarity search result associated with the input spec.

title:
Represents a single result entry from a batch similarity search.
This type combines both the input {@link Genai.Retriever.SearchSpec}
and the resulting {@link Genai.Retriever.SimilaritySearchResult} to
provide full context for each result returned in a batched query.

Useful when preserving the input query specification alongside its output
is required for auditing, debugging, or downstream processing.
name: Genai.Retriever.SimilaritySearchBatchResult
